title: Paddle Tennis to Pickleball Transition (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 132bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
From paddle tennis to pickleball
The court is bigger now
The net is taller now
The ball is plastic and slow

[Verse 1]
Paddle tennis court small twenty by fifty
Pickleball court bigger twenty forty four
Net height same thirty four inches
But wider play space we need more
Vamos vamos cover ground
Uno dos tres run around
Paddle tennis ball is heavier
Pickleball ball lighter and slower

[Pre-Chorus]
More court
More time
More court
Less crime

[Chorus]
Paddle tennis to pickleball paddle tennis to pickleball
More court more time more court more time
Paddle tennis to pickleball paddle tennis to pickleball
Vamos amigos this rhyme

[Verse 2]
Kitchen line is new addition
Seven feet from the net position
No volley in the kitchen ever
Must let it bounce never
Uno dos tres kitchen rule
Mano firme thats the school
Third shot drop is the new tool
Not the deep approach the cool

[Bridge]
Footwork is the same skill base
Hand eye coordination same pace
Learn the kitchen rule first day
Learn the third shot drop the way

[Chorus]
Paddle tennis to pickleball paddle tennis to pickleball
More court more time more court more time
Paddle tennis to pickleball paddle tennis to pickleball
Vamos amigos this rhyme

[Outro]
More court
More time
More court
Kitchen rule sublime
